decision_question: Does production ASTRA Qwen3.8 Flash-Next IQ2_XS + Strata emit a usable local function call and solve a fixed synthetic interval-union coding holdout, enough to justify building a local-only Harness² pilot adapter?
scope: One local model request and one synthetic Python function, not Harness² quality or comparative model evidence.

model.name: qwen3.8-flash-next-iq2_xs
model.profile_isolation: copy only; loopback port 8354; context 32768; no changes to production file
model.devices: RTX 3090 GPU 0 and GPU 1, sequential single server

prompt_task.contract: Return the length of the union of half-open integer intervals [start,end); empty intervals contribute zero; start > end raises ValueError.
prompt_task.pass_gate: Exactly one valid write_file call to the scratch solution.py, compilation succeeds, and all 10 hidden deterministic tests pass.

network.namespace: private user+network namespace; only loopback brought up; require no default route
network.egress: none; TEST-NET reachability must fail with ENETUNREACH

decision_rule: A pass only clears the local tool-call prerequisite for a separately preregistered Harness² quality pilot. It does not establish Harness² quality or model superiority. A fail leaves the quality pilot blocked pending a material local adapter/runtime change.
